notes: BLACKOUT v3.17 L1 on Robinhood Chain (4663), one evm_contracts launch: SwarmDesk at index 0, EndowmentEscrow at index 1 with its desk set to $contract:SwarmDesk from this same launch. Return both addresses, their indices and this launch number. SwarmDesk takes eight static words: action, policyWord, event/regulator questions and bodies, GAME_CONFIG_HASH 0x11ed7438974e96ecc962201e9c46422c7bf239d725876863fa25a56c734b20d3, and binder 0x6d51cBE774aeAe4dd40bCA2560E9bc2695A0d007 (project wallet, not an IMD address; the only account that may call bind, others get Unauthorized). Oracle signer/endpoints and LaunchFactory (0xa25b...4645) are compiled in; no protocol address is a constructor word. After L3 the binder calls bind(REGISTRY, registryCreationCode, paramsCreationCode, N_A, 1, N_A, 0, N_TOKEN); bind reads LaunchFactory.positionOf(N_TOKEN) and refuses any registry whose market is not the hook recorded for the registry's token. Keep the L2 launch number with the L1/L3 outputs for the keeper (wiring.tokenLaunch). EndowmentEscrow forwards once, permissionlessly, to the proven RewardPool of the registry the Desk bound. Accepted low/info findings are in docs/accepted-v317.md; a lost binder key leaves the Desk unbound and the endowment in escrow.
